title: Qwen3-Coder joins the model lineup
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: Qwen3-Coder landed, the cache learned TypeScript, and a few layers of project clutter disappeared.

Added Qwen3-Coder for code-focused text generation, refreshed the DeepSeek provider, and cleaned up model configuration. More options for people asking models to write the software that will inevitably ask for more models.

The Cloudflare cache implementation moved to TypeScript, while hourly usage filtering was updated for more reliable account-level tracking. Less mysterious infrastructure beneath the same simple HTTP calls.

Updated the Island AI project link and simplified the visual asset layout by moving assets to the root. Small housekeeping changes, now with fewer folders pretending to be architecture.
